title: RewriteOutput
description: Stage 3 (Rewrite) output: generated files plus every gap-filling choice made while generating them. See types.ts's Assumption/RewriteOutput and rewriter.md requirement #7 - this exists so a Rewriter guess (e.g. clamping a negative setThrust() request to 0, which the BehaviorSpec never specified) is a recorded, reportable fact instead of a silent, undiscoverable one.
